tep_alarm_dataport.boundary: Five-class TEP alarm trajectories; related process family for Sec. 5.4, but not the paper's 26 historical floods.

npp_alarm_dataport.boundary: The fixed 160-sample horizon is shorter than the book's 30-minute long-standing window, so Criterion C is descriptive only.

fcc_alarm.boundary: Complete FCC simulation runs are deduplicated by exact rising-edge trajectory before splitting; no expert flood intervals exist.

alignment.priority_boundary: The public payloads have no alarm-priority metadata; all events are encoded at p3. Priority weighting is tested only by the named Table 5.5 item.

closed_patterns.boundary: Pre-registered engineering support chosen before test scoring; the paper's minimum count two remains an original-data reproduction gate.

reporting_boundary: Fault/scenario labels are used for transfer classification only. Criterion-C candidates are not relabelled as expert-confirmed alarm floods, and no paper score is claimed.
